legalName: Segregation of Arrest Records After Acquittal, Dismissal or Withdrawal of Charges (KRS 17.142)

componentConditions.ky_criminal_record_segregation-primary-f: Applies on the court application unit. The two routes are independent — either obtains segregation, and a participant may use both; which to use is the participant's own choice and this packet never makes it.
componentConditions.ky_criminal_record_segregation-agency-wr: Applies on the written-request unit, one letter per agency the participant identifies.

routeSelectionNote: The court-application and agency-letter units are independent alternatives — either obtains segregation, and the memo records that a participant may use both. The choice between them is the participant's own (the memo's segRoute input asks it), so no election control exists and neither instrument is selected for the participant; the routing-guidance page states the choice and the stronger-route check that precedes it.

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest, from your own records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: What the arrest was for, in the applicant's own words
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: What the arrest was for, in the applicant's own words
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prints the applicant's own description and asserts nothing about any offence
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what you were arrested for, in your own words from your papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County written into the caption of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County written into the caption of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Kentucky county where the case was tried, or would have been tried had charges been filed

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption - the one in which the case was tried, or would have been tried had charges been filed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption - the one in which the case was tried, or would have been tried had charges been filed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the recorded venue is functional, not nominal, and the circuit court clerk is the checkable authority that resolves it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court in which the case was tried, or in which it would have been tried had charges been filed - no recorded source resolves the court level, so ask that county's circuit court clerk which court to name

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended - found innocent, all charges relating to the offence dismissed, or all charges relating to the offence withdrawn - and the date it ended
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the matter ended - found innocent, all charges relating to the offence dismissed, or all charges relating to the offence withdrawn - and the date it ended
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the statutory condition turns on this fact, and only the participant's records hold it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the matter ended (found innocent, all charges dismissed, or all charges withdrawn) and the date - check it against the dismissal or acquittal order from the court clerk, or ask the arresting agency or the prosecutor's office what record exists where charges were withdrawn before filing; if there is any dispute about whether ALL charges ended that way, stop and get help instead

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the underlying case, if charges were filed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the underlying case, if charges were filed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen, and the memo makes it conditional because charges may never have been filed
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the underlying case if charges were filed, copied from the court record - if no charges were ever filed, write none

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the mailing address of each agency, which you find and write yourself - no source supplies any agency address

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number, if charges were filed

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number if charges were filed - if none was, write none

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended - I was found innocent, all charges relating to the offence were dismissed, or all charges relating to the offence were withdrawn - and the date it ended
